profile.description_en: A PyroScience FireSting series optical oxygen meter for fiber-optic or probe-based oxygen sensors. It performs oxygen measurements, zero/air calibration, background correction, and reads temperature, pressure, humidity, and result registers for dissolved-oxygen or gas-phase oxygen experiments.

A PyroScience FireSting series optical oxygen meter for fiber-optic or probe-based oxygen sensors. It performs oxygen measurements, zero/air calibration, background correction, and reads temperature, pressure, humidity, and result registers for dissolved-oxygen or gas-phase oxygen experiments.
